caption: The drawing depicts a cream-colored Victorian-style dress without a head, hands, or feet shown. The dress features a fitted bodice with long sleeves, a high neckline, and a row of closely set buttons down the front. The skirt is full and draped with layers, revealing pleats and a decorative underskirt at the bottom hem, which is adorned with wide ruffles. The dress is embellished with clusters of dark red and pale yellow flowers, interspersed with green leaves, that cascade diagonally from the right shoulder, across the bodice, down the right hip, and along to the lower skirt. Additional flower arrangements are present at each wrist. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the detailed composition and color of the dress.
title: Bustle Dress
